metric_definitions.permission_violation_rate: queries with unauthorized returned documents / completed queries
metric_definitions.permission_document_violation_rate: unauthorized document occurrences / returned document occurrences; unique within each query
metric_definitions.precision: expected documents among first min(k, returned document count) / min(k, returned document count)
metric_definitions.token_count: local cl100k_base estimate of selected chunk text; excludes prompt overhead
metric_definitions.stale_count: superseded permitted candidate documents penalized before packing, not necessarily included
